productionOutcomeCases.title: Silver-streak DMAIC correction through drying and barrel-parameter standardisation
productionOutcomeCases.process: Injection moulding; Cover Engine Top part
productionOutcomeCases.baseline_or_problem: Silver-streak defects caused unstable production quality.
productionOutcomeCases.diagnosis_or_mechanism: Lack of consistent machine parameters and hopper-dryer temperature made drying and melting unstable.
productionOutcomeCases.intervention: Optimise hopper-dryer temperature, adjust barrel temperatures, and standardise machine settings based on production trials.
productionOutcomeCases.verified_outcome: Silver-streak defects fell from 197 pieces to 28 in February 2026 (85.79% reduction), then to 14 in March 2026.
productionOutcomeCases.limitations: Academic industrial case; detailed raw plant data are not bundled as an open machine-readable dataset.

productionOutcomeCases.title: Mould ejector redesign reduced injection-moulding defects
productionOutcomeCases.process: Injection moulding; PT Giken Precision Indonesia
productionOutcomeCases.baseline_or_problem: Mould/ejector design contributed to defective products.
productionOutcomeCases.diagnosis_or_mechanism: Ejector-set geometry required redesign to improve mould quality.
productionOutcomeCases.intervention: Redesign ejector set and ejector-pin geometry using DFMA.
productionOutcomeCases.verified_outcome: Defective-product rate fell from 7.19% to 2.06%; sigma improved from 3.82 to 4.25, corresponding to a reported 70.7% defect reduction.

productionOutcomeCases.title: Six Sigma reduction of incomplete/short-shot-type injection-moulding defects
productionOutcomeCases.diagnosis_or_mechanism: Multiple process causes identified through Six Sigma problem solving.
productionOutcomeCases.intervention: Corrective methods derived and implemented through DMAIC.
productionOutcomeCases.verified_outcome: Defect rate was reduced to about one quarter of its prior level and sigma level increased from 3.91 to 4.31.
productionOutcomeCases.limitations: Older case; limited accessible underlying raw data.

productionOutcomeCases.title: Automotive injection-moulding SMED workshop
productionOutcomeCases.baseline_or_problem: Long changeover time reduced flexibility and productivity.
productionOutcomeCases.diagnosis_or_mechanism: Internal setup activities and non-standard work extended mould changeover.
productionOutcomeCases.intervention: Structured SMED workshop, standard work, operator training and corrective/preventive action plan.
productionOutcomeCases.verified_outcome: Setup time fell from 48 min 30 s to 29 min 41 s, a 38.8% improvement; 13 later setup changes were monitored/validated.
productionOutcomeCases.limitations: Changeover/productivity case rather than direct molded-part defect diagnosis.

productionOutcomeCases.title: 450-ton injection machine SMED reduction at PT MWT
productionOutcomeCases.baseline_or_problem: Long mould setup created downtime and production cost.
productionOutcomeCases.diagnosis_or_mechanism: Too many internal setup tasks and insufficient simplification/standardisation.
productionOutcomeCases.intervention: Convert internal activities to external where possible and streamline remaining internal steps using SMED.
productionOutcomeCases.verified_outcome: Setup time decreased from 196 to 156 minutes (20.4%); reported daily production cost fell by Rp333,333, also about 20.4%.
productionOutcomeCases.limitations: Single-machine case; economic figures are context-specific.

productionOutcomeCases.title: TPM + SMED + machine-learning operational improvement in plastics manufacturing
productionOutcomeCases.evidence_class: industrial case with historical-data analysis and simulation
productionOutcomeCases.process: Plastic container manufacturing using injection and blow moulding
productionOutcomeCases.baseline_or_problem: Low OEE (61.87%), low machine availability and high rework.
productionOutcomeCases.diagnosis_or_mechanism: Maintenance losses, setup losses and quality variability jointly reduced operational efficiency.
productionOutcomeCases.intervention: TPM, SMED and machine-learning defect/burr prediction.
productionOutcomeCases.verified_outcome: Reported OEE increased from 61.87% to 80.86%, with reductions in downtime and rework.
productionOutcomeCases.limitations: Mixed injection/blow-moulding operation; some reported results rely on simulation/historical analysis.

productionOutcomeCases.title: Taguchi optimisation of jar/cap injection moulding shrinkage
productionOutcomeCases.process: Plastic injection moulding of jars and caps
productionOutcomeCases.diagnosis_or_mechanism: Process-parameter combination was driving shrinkage variation.
productionOutcomeCases.verified_outcome: Defects dropped from 982 to 92 per ~7,000-part daily lot; defect rate fell from 14.03% to 1.31%.
productionOutcomeCases.limitations: Specific molded jar/cap geometry and process window.

productionOutcomeCases.title: AI-integrated Six Sigma multi-defect optimisation on a washing-machine control-panel line
productionOutcomeCases.evidence_class: industrial measured optimisation with on-site trial
productionOutcomeCases.baseline_or_problem: Gas-trap burn, short-shot, sink-mark and flash defects interact, making single-defect tuning unstable.
productionOutcomeCases.diagnosis_or_mechanism: Injection pressures/speeds and holding parameters drive interacting defect probabilities.
productionOutcomeCases.intervention: SHAP-informed predictive modelling plus NSGA-II multi-objective parameter optimisation.
productionOutcomeCases.verified_outcome: Overall defect reduction 84.7% relative to baseline. For the three scrap CTQs, baseline 84 defects / 1,284 parts (DPMO 21,806.9; long-term sigma 2.018) improved to 3 defects / 300 parts (DPMO 3,333.3; long-term sigma 2.713); short shots and sink marks were 0/300 and GTB 3/300.
productionOutcomeCases.limitations: Single product/line; flash was reworkable and excluded from the three-CTQ scrap sigma calculation.

productionOutcomeCases.title: Toshiba injection-machine OEE recovery using FMEA and six-big-loss analysis
productionOutcomeCases.process: Toshiba IS 450 GSW injection moulding machine
productionOutcomeCases.diagnosis_or_mechanism: Dominant equipment/process losses depressed availability and performance despite high quality rate.
productionOutcomeCases.intervention: Improvement actions based on six-big-loss/FMEA/root-cause analysis.
productionOutcomeCases.verified_outcome: Average OEE increased from 26.43% to 78.87%, exceeding the company's 75% target.
productionOutcomeCases.limitations: Case-study design; exact contribution of each corrective action is not separately randomized.

productionOutcomeCases.title: REACT-5 IoT-MES root-cause and escalation rollout across 75 injection machines
productionOutcomeCases.baseline_or_problem: Poorly structured event/root-cause data limited corrective action, AI readiness and traceability.
productionOutcomeCases.diagnosis_or_mechanism: Unstructured event tracking and inconsistent root-cause labeling slowed escalation and weakened corrective-action consistency.
productionOutcomeCases.intervention: Deploy REACT-5 structured 5M root-cause/escalation workflow integrated with IoT and MES.
productionOutcomeCases.verified_outcome: Descriptive plant averages: OEE 73.14%→80.31%, scrap 2.57%→1.41% (45% reduction), MTBF 18.39→22.93 h. Machine-level paired analysis (n=75) also found statistically significant KPI improvements.
productionOutcomeCases.limitations: Plant-wide before/after rollout without randomized control; authors report subgroup and confound checks.
